description: This file defines the AgentWorkspace enum which manages agent workspace directories and related templates, including functions for path resolution, directory inspection, bootstrap management, and default template provisioning. It encapsulates logic for setting up, verifying, and handling agent workspace files like AGENTS.md, IDENTITY.md, and BOOTSTRAP.md.

methods.name: displayPath
methods.description: Converts a file URL to a user-friendly string, replacing the home directory path with '~' for brevity.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Resolves a user input string into a URL for the workspace directory, expanding tildes to full paths or returning a default URL if input is empty.

methods.name: agentsURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for the AGENTS.md file within the given workspace directory.

methods.name: workspaceEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of entries in the workspace directory, filtering out ignored entries.

methods.name: isWorkspaceEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the workspace directory exists and is empty.

methods.name: isTemplateOnlyWorkspace
methods.description: Determines if the workspace contains only template files and no additional content.

methods.name: bootstrapSafety
methods.description: Assesses whether the workspace is safe to bootstrap based on existing files and directory state.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the workspace by creating necessary files and directories, optionally seeding templates, and returning the URL of the agents file.

methods.name: needsBootstrap
methods.description: Checks if a workspace requires initial bootstrap setup based on its contents.

methods.name: hasIdentity
methods.description: Determines whether the IDENTITY.md file exists and contains non-empty value lines.

methods.name: defaultTemplate
methods.description: Provides a default content string for the AGENTS.md template.

methods.name: defaultSoulTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the SOUL.md template.

methods.name: defaultIdentityTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the IDENTITY.md template.

methods.name: defaultUserTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the USER.md template.

methods.name: defaultBootstrapTemplate
methods.description: Provides the default content for the BOOTSTRAP.md template.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Attempts to load and return the first non-empty template content from predefined URLs, otherwise returns a fallback string.

methods.name: templateURLs
methods.description: Returns a list of possible URLs where templates may be located, including resources in app bundle, dev directories, and current working directory.

methods.name: devTemplateURL
methods.description: Calculates and returns a URL pointing to a development templates directory relative to the source code location.

methods.name: stripFrontMatter
methods.description: Removes YAML front matter from a template string if present, returning the main content.
